## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 10.09.2026 - 16.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Geraldine Rolo_, 16.09.2026, 1/5: "I had subscribed to a trial period and I immediately canceled the subscription in the playstore to avoid deductions in the future. the app no longer appeared under my subscription list. i received a notification from my bank informing me that this app had deducted money from my account without my consent"
            2. _E D_, 16.09.2026, 1/5: "this app charged me for subscription without giving any notice to give me time to cancel the free trial and know I cannot go to the billing terms in the app. because it says no internet connection eventhough I clearly have internet. this is clearly a scam."
            3. _David Thurlow_, 16.09.2026, 1/5: "I gave this app a trial. It wasn't for me so I tried to cancel my subscription. That was nearly a year ago. I have been charged every quarter since. Have tried to remove my card details without success. Beware!!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      6 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 23.05.2026 - 15.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Bonolo Rambau_, 15.09.2026, 1/5: "the app glitches, i can't even access my meal plan. I have been a member for less than an hour"
            2. _Jerick Órdenes_, 11.09.2026, 1/5: "The app freezes on every start and sometimes crashes. It's very annoying for a paid app."
            3. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23.05.2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
<!--/ir-theme-->
